# Critical-Care Literature Digest — January 2099

*2 articles across fixture sections.*

---

## ECMO / Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation

[The Unknown Others of Neonatal Respiratory Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation](https://doi.org/10.1097/MAT.0000000000002822) — ASAIO Journal
ELSO registry study reclassifying neonatal respiratory ECMO runs into 13 modern diagnostic categories.

## Respiratory / Pulmonary & ARDS

[Balancing lung and brain: physiological strategies for ARDS management in acute brain injury](https://doi.org/10.1007/s00134-026-08595-z) — Intensive Care Medicine
Narrative review synthesizing the physiologic conflict between lung-protective ventilation and cerebral-protective targets.
